points.description: States that the reservoir area curve is a plot/graph/curve of water spread area (surface area of the reservoir) against reservoir elevation (water level/depth).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if it is called a plot/relationship of area with something vague or partly right (e.g. area vs depth/level without 'water spread' or 'surface'), or if the axes are only loosely described.

points.description: Correctly pairs the two variables: water spread area as one variable and reservoir elevation as the other, with no wrong variable (e.g. not volume or capacity) given as the plotted quantity.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying it is a plot or graph of water spread (surface) area against reservoir elevation or water level, in any wording. Give part marks if the idea is vague, e.g. area against depth with no mention of water spread, or only half of the pair is clear. Give 0 if the curve is described as storage/capacity versus elevation, or if the answer is unrelated.
